papers.title: A machine learning approach for efficient uncertainty quantification using multiscale methods
papers.abstract: Several multiscale methods account for sub-grid scale features using coarse scale basis functions. For example, in the Multiscale Finite Volume method the coarse scale basis functions are obtained by solving a set of local problems over dual-grid cells. We introduce a data-driven approach for the estimation of these coarse scale basis functions. Specifically, we employ a neural network predictor fitted using a set of solution samples from which it learns to generate subsequent basis functions at a lower computational cost than solving the local problems. The computational advantage of this approach is realized for uncertainty quantification tasks where a large number of realizations has to be evaluated. We attribute the ability to learn these basis functions to the modularity of the local problems and the redundancy of the permeability patches between samples. The proposed method is evaluated on elliptic problems yielding very promising results.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模中的不确定性量化，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics contexts, nor does it handle optimization constraints or multi-objective design; it focuses on efficient basis function generation for elliptic problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低多尺度方法中不确定性量化的计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 用神经网络从解样本中学习粗尺度基函数。
summary_zh.result: 在椭圆问题上取得良好精度和加速效果。
summary_zh.validation: 基于椭圆PDE的数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of uncertainty quantification in multiscale simulations by learning coarse-scale basis functions.
summary_en.method: A neural network predictor is trained on solution samples to generate basis functions, bypassing local problem solves.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves promising accuracy and significant speed-up on elliptic problems.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through numerical experiments on elliptic PDEs with varying permeability fields.

papers.title: Experimental apparatus for overlapping a ground-state cooled ion with ultracold atoms
papers.abstract: Experimental realizations of charged ions and neutral atoms in overlapping traps are gaining increasing interest due to their wide research application ranging from chemistry at the quantum level to quantum simulations of solid state systems. In this paper, we describe our experimental system in which we overlap a single ground-state cooled ion trapped in a linear Paul trap with a cloud of ultracold atoms such that both constituents are in the μK regime. Excess micromotion (EMM) currently limits atom–ion interaction energy to the mK energy scale and above. We demonstrate spectroscopy methods and compensation techniques which characterize and reduce the ion’s parasitic EMM energy to the μK regime even for ion crystals of several ions. We further give a substantial review on the non-equilibrium dynamics which governs atom–ion systems. The non-equilibrium dynamics is manifested by a power law distribution of the ion’s energy. We also give an overview on the coherent and non-coherent thermometry tools which can be used to characterize the ion’s energy distribution after single to many atom–ion collisions.

papers.title: MENCEGAH PENYEBARAN PAHAM RADIKALISME PADA SEKOLAH
papers.abstract: The problem discussed in this thesis is how the strategy of PAI clusters teacher in preventing the spread of radicalism in MAN 1 of Bengkulu City, and its supporting and inhibiting factors. The purpose of this study intends to describe the strategy of PAI teacher teachers in preventing the spread of radicalism in Madrasah AliyahNegeri 1 Bengkulu  city, describing the  supporting factors  and  obstacles of PAI teachers in preventing the  spread of radicalism in Madrasah AliyahNegeri 1 Bengkulu  City. The method used  is descriptive qualitative  with the type of field research (field research). Data collection techniques: observation, interviews, and documentation. Data analysis  techniques: data  reduction, data  display  and  conclusion. The result  of the  research shows  that  the strategy of PAI teacher in preventing the spread of radicalism in MAN 1 is divided into two types: the strategy in the learning process in the classroom by using the active learning method and the Qur’an method of learning,  and the process Learning outside the classroom is: by holding various religious activities, forming a team  of worship in school, in cooperation with the police such as Sat. Bintal, and Sat. Binmas, in cooperation with the provincial kemenag, held  workshops and  religious socialization in schools.  Supporting  factors  in the implementation of prevention strategies of the  spread of radicalism in schools  is a sufficient  means of infrastructure both  from learning  resources, the  allocation of study time  and  teachers of the  PAI family. Inhibiting factors  are  misuse of informatics (IT) technology by students, the absence of special  programs in preventing the school’s  radical hazards, the lack of parental support for school policies, the lack of cooperation between schools with guardians, teachers with guardians, and the lack of Cooperation among  teachers.

papers.title: STUDI KUANTITATIF DAN KUALITATIF KEMAMPUAN BERPIKIR KREATIF DAN PENGUASAAN KONSEP MATERI FLUIDA STATIS MELALUI MODEL PROJECT BASED LEARNING PADA SISWA KELAS XI IPA DI SMAN 1 TANAH GROGOT TAHUN AJARAN 2017/2018
papers.abstract: RINGKASAN Fajrina, Rani Nur Arifah Agus. 2017. Studi Kuantitatif Dan Kualitatif : Kemampuan Berpikir Kreatif dan Penguasaan Konsep Materi Fluida Statis Melalui Model Project Based Learning pada Siswa Kelas XI IPA di SMAN 1 Tanah Grogot Tahun Ajaran 2017/2018 . Tesis. Program Studi Pendidikan Fisika, Pascasarjana Universitas Negeri Malang. Pembimbing (I) Dr. Supriyono Koes Handayanto, M.Pd, M.A, (II) Prof. Arif Hidayat, M.Si., Ph.D Kata Kunci: project based learning (PjBL), penguasaan konsep, kemampuan berpikir kreatif Penguasaan konsep dan kemampuan berpikir kreatif merupakan kompetensi yang diperlukan dalam proses pembelajaran. Namun penelitian terdahulu menunjukkan bahwa penguasaan konsep dan kemampuan berpikir kreatif peserta didik masih rendah. Hal ini dikarenakan peserta didik masih menggunakan metode menghapal yang merujuk pada pembelajaran berasaskan fakta. Selain itu kegiatan pembelajaran yang pasif tidak dapat mengembangkan kemampuan berpikir kreatif peserta didik. Salah satu pembelajaran yang tepat untuk digunakan dalam mengatasi permasalahan ini adalah model project based learning (PjBL) yang mana dalam pelaksanaannya pembelajaran yang dilakukan peserta didik merupakan pembelajaran aktif. Melalui pembelajaran ini peserta didik memperoleh pengetahuannya dengan kokoh dan bermakna dengan mengkonstruksikan pada tugas dan pekerjaan yang autentik. Selain itu, melalui pembelajaran yang aktif dan bermakna peserta didik akan terbantu dalam mengembangkan kemampuan berpikir kreatifnya. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk, 1) mengetahui adakah pengaruh model pembelajaran project based learning terhadap penguasaan konsep dan kemampuan berpikir kreatif siswa pada materi fluida statis setelah mengontrol kemampuan awal, dan 2) menjelaskan  bagaimana model project based learning mempengaruhi penguasaan konsep dan kemampuan berpikir kreatif siswa pada materi fluida statis . Metode penelitian yang digunakan dalam penelitian yaitu menggunakan mixedmethods dengan desain rancangan explanatory . Adapun desain penelitian kuantitatif menggunakan desain quasi experimental tipe nonequivalent control group design dan subjek penelitian sebanyak 32 peserta didik eksperimen dan 32 peserta didik kelas kontrol, dan desain penelitian kualitatif menggunakan Studi kasus dengan teknik wawancara semi terstruktur dengan subjek penelitian sebanyak 6 peserta didik dari kelas eksperimen. Instrumen yang digunakan berupa instrumen perlakuan (silabus, RPP, dan LKPD). Instrumen pengukuran yang digunakan berupa soal tes kemampuan awal, dan posttest penguasaan konsep dan kemampuan berpikir kreatif. Instrumen yang digunakan telah melalui uji ahli dan uji lapangan. Data hasil penelitian kuantitatif dianalisis menggunakan uji hipotesis berupa analisis kovarian (MANCOVA). Hasil penelitian menunjukkan: 1) Model project based learning mempengaruhi penguasaan konsep dan kemampuan berpikir kreatif peserta didik setelah kemampuan awal peserta didik dikontrol, dan 2) penggunaan project based learning melalui serangkaian kegiatan pembelajaran yang mendukung penguasaan konsep dan kemampuan berpikir kreatif memudahkan peserta didik dalam menyelesaikan tugas proyek sehingga peserta didik dapat membangun konsep dan /menumbuhkan kemampuan berpikir kreatif mereka. SUMMARY Fajrina, Rani Nur Arifah Agus. 2017. Quantitative And Qualitative Studies The Ability of Creative Thinking and Conceptual Understanding Through Project Based Learning Model In Student Class XI IPA at SMAN 1 Grogot Ground Year 2017/2018 (Static Fluid Material). Thesis. Physics Education Study Program, Graduate Program of State University of Malang. Advisor (I) Dr. Supriyono Koes Handayanto, M.Pd, M.A, (II) Prof. Arif Hidayat, M.Si., Ph.D. Keywords: project based learning (PjBL), conceptual understanding, creative thinking ability Mastery of concepts and the ability to think creatively is a necessary competence in the learning process. However, previous research indicates that the mastery of the concept and the ability of creative thinking of learners is still low. This is because learners are still using the method of memorization that refers to learning based on facts. In addition, passive learning activities can not develop creative thinking skills of learners. One of the proper learning to be used in overcoming this problem is the model of project based learning (PjBL) which in the implementation of learning by students is an active learning. Through this learning learners gain knowledge with a solid and meaningful by constructing on tasks and work that is authentic. In addition, through active learning and meaningful learners will be helpful in developing the ability to think creatively. This study aims to 1) to know whether there is any influence of learning based on project based learning model on the mastery of the concept and the ability of students 'creative thinking on static fluid material after controlling the initial capability, and 2) to explain how the project based learning model influences the mastery of students' static fluid material. The research method used in this research is using mixedmethods with explanatory design design. The design of quantitative research using quasi experimental design type nonequivalent control group design and the subject of research as much as 32 experimental students and 32 students control class, and qualitative research design using case study with semi structured interview technique with the subject of research as much as 6 students from the experimental class . Instruments used in the form of treatment instruments (syllabus, RPP, and LKPD). Measurement instruments used include test preliminary skills, and posttest mastery of concepts and creative thinking skills. The instrument used has been through expert test and field test. Quantitative research result data is analyzed using hypothesis test in the form of analysis covariance (MANCOVA). The result of the research shows: 1) The project based learning model influences the mastery of the concept and the creative thinking ability of the learners after the initial ability of the learners is controlled, and 2) the use of project based learning through a series of learning activities that support the mastery of the concept and the ability to think creatively facilitate learners in completing project tasks so that learners can build concepts and / foster their creative thinking skills.

summary_zh.motivation: 学生概念掌握和创造性思维能力低下，需要改进教学方法。
summary_zh.method: 采用混合方法，准实验设计结合半结构化访谈，使用项目式学习模型。

summary_en.motivation: To address low conceptual understanding and creative thinking skills in physics students through active learning.
summary_en.method: A mixed-methods study with quasi-experimental design and semi-structured interviews, implementing project-based learning (PjBL) for static fluid topics.
summary_en.result: PjBL significantly improved students' conceptual mastery and creative thinking after controlling for prior ability.
summary_en.validation: Quantitative validation via MANCOVA and qualitative validation through thematic analysis of interviews.
